title: Meet the vessels

copy.headline: One standardized platform — N30 Pioneer and N45 Explorer.
copy.body: Electric hydrofoils built for network service: high throughput, low wake, near-silent, software-defined. Cabins are built for the working crossing — comfortable individual seats, fold-out work tables, and Starlink Wi-Fi underway.

interior_footnote: Interior images are design renderings; final cabin configurations may vary.

cards.interior_caption: Eight-seat executive cabin — panoramic glass, boardroom-quiet.
cards.blurb: Private point-to-point for leadership and hybrid pods — your team’s boat, not a shared boarding wait.
cards.blurb_fleet_investors: Eight-seat executive feeder: reserved corporate slots as the spine, with shoulder charters on a ~$1M asset.

cards.interior_caption: Individual seats, fold-out work tables, Starlink Wi-Fi — the crossing is working time, not lost time.
cards.interior_caption_fleet_investors: The cabin is the pricing power — premium interiors are what defend premium seat rates.
cards.blurb: Premium network commute vessel — foilborne, near-silent, built for campus-scale seats on a scheduled corridor.
cards.blurb_fleet_investors: Premium network asset for investor underwriting — high seat throughput, redeployable across network corridors.
